description: Smart Water Meter is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Gallo, Vincenzo, Salvatore Dello Iacono (University of Salerno). Water leakage problems increased over the last few years, and tools and techniques appeared to solve this widespread problem. The still unresolved problem concerns the identification of water leaks at the nearest point; at the household level, the most common and inexpensive devices are still mechanical meters, which cannot detect leaks. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
